m-egg-muffins.name: Veggie Egg Muffins
ing: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the pan
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Oil a 12-cup muffin pan well, or use silicone cups.
Split the spinach, pepper and onion between the cups.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and garlic powder, then pour over the vegetables until each cup is about three-quarters full.
Bake 20–25 minutes, until the centers are set.
Cool on a rack before packing so they don’t get soggy. Reheat 30–45 seconds in the microwave.
m-egg-muffins.note: Swap in any vegetables you have. Cooked ground turkey or chicken makes them more filling.

m-yogurt-jars.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait Jars
steps: Stir the honey and chia seeds into the yogurt.
Spoon the yogurt into five jars and top with berries.
Pack the granola separately (small bags or a dry container) so it stays crunchy, and add it when you eat.
m-yogurt-jars.note: Frozen berries work too; they thaw into a sauce by morning.

m-overnight-oats.name: Protein Overnight Oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey, vanilla and cinnamon in a big bowl.
Divide between five jars and top with banana.
Refrigerate overnight. Eat cold, or microwave 1–2 minutes with a splash of milk.
m-overnight-oats.note: Stir a scoop of protein powder in with a little extra milk for about 20 g more protein.

m-breakfast-burritos.name: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil over medium heat until soft, about 6 minutes. Add the beans and cumin.
Whisk the eggs with the salt, pour into the pan and scramble until just set. Stir in the salsa and let it cool.
Warm the tortillas so they fold without cracking. Fill each one, fold in the sides and roll up.
Wrap each burrito in foil or plastic. Refrigerate or freeze.
From frozen: unwrap, cover with a damp paper towel and microwave 2–3 minutes, turning halfway.

m-burrito-bowls.name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
steps: Start the rice. When it’s done, stir in the juice of one lime and some chopped cilantro.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the chicken with the oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C). Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm the beans and corn together in a pan or the microwave.
Pack rice, beans and corn, and chicken into five containers. Keep salsa and lime wedges on the side.

m-med-bowls.name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowls
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in 3 cups of water, about 15 minutes. Fluff and cool.
Rub the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, the Italian seasoning, garlic powder and half the salt. Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 18–22 minutes, to 165°F (74°C). Slice.
Whisk the tahini with the juice of one lemon, the rest of the oil and salt, and water until pourable.
Pack quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and chicken. Keep the sauce in a small container.
m-med-bowls.note: Cucumbers and tomatoes stay crisper if you pack them in their own section.

m-sheet-pan.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line two sheet pans.
Toss the sweet potatoes and onion with half the oil and seasoning. Roast 10 minutes.
Toss the chicken and broccoli with the rest, add them to the pans and spread everything out.
Roast 20–25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are tender.

m-turkey-chili.name: Turkey & Bean Chili
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil in a big pot, breaking it up. Add the onion, peppers and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in the spices and cook 1 minute.
Add both tomatoes, the beans and 1 cup of water. Simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste for salt. Cool, then portion. Freeze in flat bags or containers.

m-stir-fry.name: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ing: 1½ lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Start the rice.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, cornstarch, sesame oil and ¼ cup water for the sauce.
Cook the chicken in 1 tbsp oil over high heat until browned and cooked through, then set it aside.
Add the rest of the oil, then the broccoli, peppers and snap peas. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes, adding the garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and stir until glossy. Pack with the rice.

m-curry.name: Chickpea & Lentil Curry
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 2 cups of water. Simmer 15–20 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the chickpeas and spinach until it wilts. Season and pack with the rice.
m-curry.note: Top with a spoonful of Greek yogurt for extra protein.

m-egg-roll-bowl.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl (Turkey)
steps: Brown the turkey in a large pan, breaking it up.
Add the garlic, ginger and most of the green onions for 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce and vinegar. Cook, stirring, until the cabbage is just tender, 4–5 minutes.
Finish with the sesame oil, seeds and remaining green onions.
m-egg-roll-bowl.note: Low in carbs on its own. Add rice if you want it around training.

m-meatballs.name: Baked Turkey Meatballs
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a sheet pan.
Mix everything except the marinara with your hands, just until combined.
Roll into about 30 balls and bake 18–20 minutes, to 165°F (74°C).
Warm in the marinara, or freeze plain on the pan first, then bag them so they don’t stick together.
m-meatballs.note: Serve with pasta, rice, roasted vegetables or in a sub roll.

m-tuna-salad.name: Greek Yogurt Tuna Salad
steps: Mix everything in a bowl, breaking up the tuna.
Taste and add salt or more lemon if you like.
Pack in four containers. Eat in a wrap, on lettuce, or with crackers.

m-chicken-salad.name: Canned Chicken Salad
steps: Flake the chicken into a bowl.
Stir in everything else.
Pack in four containers. Good in a wrap, on greens or with crackers.

m-salmon-patties.name: Canned Salmon Patties
steps: Flake the salmon into a bowl, removing large bones and skin if you like.
Mix in the eggs, breadcrumbs, green onions, mustard, garlic powder and the zest of the lemon. Shape 8 patties.
Cook in the oil over medium heat, 3–4 minutes a side, until golden and hot through.
Cool and pack with lemon wedges.

m-hb-eggs.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 11–12 minutes (9 for jammy yolks).
Move them straight to a bowl of ice water for 10 minutes.
Refrigerate in the shell; they peel easiest the next day.

m-snack-box.name: Protein Snack Boxes
steps: Hard-boil the eggs (see Hard-Boiled Eggs), cool and peel.
Divide the hummus between five small containers.
Fill five boxes with two eggs, vegetables, grapes and a handful of crackers in a separate bag.

m-energy-bites.name: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
steps: Stir everything together. If it’s too dry, add a spoon of milk; too wet, more oats.
Chill 15 minutes, then roll into 16 balls.
Keep in the fridge or freezer.

m-taco-chicken.name: Taco Chicken (batch)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Mix the spices and salt, then rub them over the chicken with the oil.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, squeeze the lime over and slice or shred.
m-taco-chicken.note: Use it in bowls, wraps, salads or on eggs. Make a second flavor too so you don’t get tired of one.

m-italian-chicken.name: Italian Herb Chicken (batch)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Rub the chicken with the oil, seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Bake 18–22 minutes, to 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, squeeze the lemon over and slice.

m-rice.name: Batch Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

m-quinoa.name: Batch Quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa well.
Simmer in 3 cups of salted water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff and cool.

m-roast-veg.name: Roasted Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the vegetables with the oil and seasoning.
Spread over two sheet pans so they roast instead of steam.
Roast 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until browned at the edges.

m-black-beans.name: Seasoned Black Beans
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans and ½ cup water. Simmer 8–10 minutes, mashing a few.
Finish with the lime juice and salt.

m-bone-broth.name: Chicken Bone Broth
steps: Saturday night, put everything in a slow cooker and cover with water, about 12 cups.
Cook on low 12–24 hours.
Strain, chill, then lift off the fat.
Use it to cook rice, beans and lentils, or sip a mug in the evening. Freeze extra in 1–2 cup portions.
m-bone-broth.note: Chicken feet make the most gelatin. Nutrition is an estimate for the strained broth.

m-liver-crumble.name: Turkey-Liver Crumble
steps: Blend the chicken livers until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and the blended liver and brown, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in the cumin, paprika and pepper for the last 2 minutes and season with the salt.
Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-liver-crumble.note: About 1 part liver to 8 parts turkey: the liver adds iron, B12 and vitamin A without tasting like liver. Liver is very high in vitamin A, so keep this to 2–3 servings a week, and skip the liver if you’re pregnant.

m-thighs.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the thighs dry.
Toss the thighs with the oil, salt and the zest and juice of the lemon and the za’atar (or any spice rub).
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes, until 175°F (80°C) inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-thighs.note: Thighs stay juicy through reheating better than breast.

m-broth-rice.name: Brown Rice in Broth
steps: Rinse the rice. Bring the broth and salt to a boil.
Add the rice, cover and simmer on low 40–45 minutes, until the broth is absorbed.
Rest 10 minutes covered, fluff, and cool before packing.
m-broth-rice.note: Cooked and cooled rice has a little more resistant starch, which feeds gut bacteria.

m-broth-beans.name: Beans in Broth (from dry)
ing: 1 lb dry black beans or chickpeas
steps: Saturday night, soak the beans in plenty of water with a spoon of salt.
Drain and rinse. Simmer in the broth with the bay leaf, partly covered, 1–1½ hours until tender, adding water if needed.
Season with the salt and cool in their liquid.
m-broth-beans.note: Soaking shortens the cooking and makes beans easier on the gut. Freeze extra in their liquid.

m-lentils.name: Lentils in Broth
ing: 1½ cups dry green or brown lentils
steps: Rinse the lentils.
Simmer in the broth with the bay leaf 20–25 minutes, until tender but not mushy.
Drain any extra broth, season and cool.

m-farro.name: Batch Farro
steps: Rinse the farro. Simmer in the broth, uncovered, 25–30 minutes until chewy-tender.
Drain, season and cool.

m-bep.name: Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the peas and broth and simmer 8–10 minutes.
Season with the salt.

m-sheet-veg.name: Sheet-Pan Vegetables & Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the green vegetables, carrots and onion with half the oil and salt on one pan, and the sweet potatoes with the rest on another.
Roast 30–35 minutes, stirring once.

m-roast-cauli.name: Roasted Cauliflower & Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything together and spread over two sheet pans.
Roast 30 minutes, stirring once, until browned at the edges.

m-cuke-salad.name: Cucumber, Tomato & Parsley Salad
steps: Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, parsley and onion.
Dress with the lemon juice, oil and salt when you eat, so it stays crisp.

m-roast-sweet-potato.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the cubes with the oil and salt and roast 30–35 minutes, turning once.

m-roast-broccoli.name: Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything together and roast 18–22 minutes, until the edges char.

m-slaw-asian.name: Cabbage & Carrot Slaw
steps: Toss the vegetables.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, honey and salt, and toss with the slaw.
m-slaw-asian.note: Keeps 4 days; it softens a little each day.

m-roast-peppers.name: Roasted Peppers & Onions
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything together and roast 25 minutes, stirring once.

m-slaw-lime.name: Lime Cabbage Slaw
steps: Toss the cabbage, onion and cilantro.
Dress with the lime juice, oil and salt.

m-collards.name: Garlicky Collards
ing: 2 bunches collard greens, stems removed, sliced
steps: Warm the oil and garlic in a big pot for 1 minute.
Add the collards and broth, cover, and simmer 15–20 minutes until tender.
Finish with the vinegar and salt.

m-butternut.name: Roasted Butternut Squash
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything together and roast 30–35 minutes, turning once.

m-soaked-oats.name: Kefir Soaked Oats
steps: Mix the oats, kefir, chia and flax and divide between four jars.
Top with berries and a drizzle of honey.
Refrigerate overnight. Eat cold.
m-soaked-oats.note: Plain yogurt works instead of kefir.

m-sauce-tahini.name: Tahini-Lemon Sauce
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Whisk in about ⅓ cup water, a little at a time, until it pours.

m-sauce-garlic-yogurt.name: Garlic Yogurt Sauce
steps: Stir everything together.

m-sauce-gochujang.name: Gochujang-Miso Sauce
steps: Whisk everything with about 3 tbsp water until smooth.

m-sauce-peanut.name: Peanut-Ginger Sauce
steps: Whisk everything, adding warm water (about ¼ cup) until it pours.

m-sauce-verde.name: Salsa Verde
steps: Roast the tomatillos, jalapeño and onion at 450°F (230°C) for 15 minutes, until blistered.
Blend with the cilantro, lime juice and salt.
m-sauce-verde.note: Makes about 2 cups; a serving is ¼ cup.

m-sauce-chipotle.name: Chipotle Yogurt Sauce
steps: Stir everything together. Add more chipotle for heat.

m-sauce-ranch.name: Herb Yogurt Ranch
steps: Stir everything together. Thin with kefir or water if you like.

m-sauce-hothoney.name: Hot Honey Vinaigrette
steps: Shake everything in a jar.

m-thighs-zaatar.name: Za’atar Lemon Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the thighs dry.
Toss the thighs with the oil, salt and the zest and juice of the lemons, the za’atar and the garlic.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes, until 175°F (80°C) inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-thighs-zaatar.note: Thighs stay juicy through reheating better than breast.

m-crumble-levant.name: Cumin-Allspice Turkey-Liver Crumble
steps: Blend the chicken livers until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and the blended liver and brown, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in the cumin, allspice and cinnamon for the last 2 minutes and season with the salt.
Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-crumble-levant.note: About 1 part liver to 8 parts turkey: the liver adds iron, B12 and vitamin A without tasting like liver. Liver is very high in vitamin A, so keep this to 2–3 servings a week, and skip the liver if you’re pregnant.

m-thighs-gochujang.name: Gochujang Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the thighs dry.
Toss the thighs with the oil, salt and the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil and garlic, stirred together.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes, until 175°F (80°C) inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-thighs-gochujang.note: Thighs stay juicy through reheating better than breast.

m-crumble-ginger.name: Ginger-Garlic Turkey-Liver Crumble
steps: Blend the chicken livers until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and the blended liver and brown, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in the ginger, tamari, sesame oil and green onions for the last 2 minutes and season with the salt.
Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-crumble-ginger.note: About 1 part liver to 8 parts turkey: the liver adds iron, B12 and vitamin A without tasting like liver. Liver is very high in vitamin A, so keep this to 2–3 servings a week, and skip the liver if you’re pregnant.

m-thighs-chili-lime.name: Chili-Lime Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the thighs dry.
Toss the thighs with the oil, salt and the zest and juice of the limes, the chili powder, cumin and garlic.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes, until 175°F (80°C) inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-thighs-chili-lime.note: Thighs stay juicy through reheating better than breast.

m-crumble-taco.name: Taco-Spiced Turkey-Liver Crumble
steps: Blend the chicken livers until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and the blended liver and brown, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika and oregano for the last 2 minutes and season with the salt.
Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-crumble-taco.note: About 1 part liver to 8 parts turkey: the liver adds iron, B12 and vitamin A without tasting like liver. Liver is very high in vitamin A, so keep this to 2–3 servings a week, and skip the liver if you’re pregnant.

m-thighs-paprika.name: Smoked-Paprika Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the thighs dry.
Toss the thighs with the oil, salt and the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and cayenne.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes, until 175°F (80°C) inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-thighs-paprika.note: Thighs stay juicy through reheating better than breast.

m-crumble-sage.name: Sage & Black Pepper Turkey-Liver Crumble
steps: Blend the chicken livers until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and the blended liver and brown, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains.
Stir in the sage, pepper and thyme for the last 2 minutes and season with the salt.
Freeze half and move it to the fridge Wednesday night.
m-crumble-sage.note: About 1 part liver to 8 parts turkey: the liver adds iron, B12 and vitamin A without tasting like liver. Liver is very high in vitamin A, so keep this to 2–3 servings a week, and skip the liver if you’re pregnant.

m-ginger-cubes.name: Ginger-Turmeric Morning Cubes
m-ginger-cubes.size: 1 cube in ½ cup hot water
steps: Blend everything (juice of 3 lemons, zest of 1) with 1 cup water or coconut water on high 60–90 seconds until smooth. Don’t strain.
Pour into a 1 oz silicone ice-cube tray and freeze overnight, then store the cubes in a freezer bag up to 3 months.
Each morning, pour ½ cup just-boiled water over one cube and stir until it melts. Stir again before drinking.
Rinse your mouth with water afterward and wait 30 minutes before brushing; the lemon and vinegar are acidic.
m-ginger-cubes.note: Start with half a cube. Check with a doctor first if you take blood thinners or diabetes medicine, have gallstones or bad reflux, or have surgery coming up. A habit, not a treatment.

m-reel-chicken-rice.name: Big-Batch Chicken & Rice
steps: Cook the rice with 4½ cups of water and half the salt, covered, about 18 minutes. Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Toss the chicken with the oil, the rest of the salt, the garlic powder and paprika.
Cook in a large pan over medium-high heat 6–7 minutes a side, until it reaches 165°F (74°C). Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Split the rice and chicken between four containers and drizzle with the soy sauce.
m-reel-chicken-rice.note: Bulking: these are big on purpose. For a cut, make 6 smaller bowls from the same batch.

m-reel-cereal-shake.name: Cereal & Shake Breakfast
ing: 1 cup whole milk, for the shake
steps: Pour the cereal and 1½ cups milk into a big bowl and slice the banana on top.
Shake the protein powder with 1 cup milk.
m-reel-cereal-shake.note: Pick a cereal with some fiber. For a lighter version use 2% milk and one cup of cereal.

m-reel-half-plate.name: Half-Plate Protein Plates
steps: Cook the rice with 2 cups of water, covered, about 40 minutes (or use a rice cooker).
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the chicken and broccoli with the oil, salt, pepper and garlic powder on a sheet pan.
Roast 18–22 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
Fill half of each container with sliced chicken, a quarter with rice and a quarter with broccoli. Squeeze lemon over.
m-reel-half-plate.note: Two plates like this a day plus one or two snacks covers most of a beginner’s protein (estimate).

m-reel-ice-cream.name: Protein Ice Cream Pint
steps: Blend or shake everything until smooth and pour into an ice-cream maker pint.
Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Spin on the light ice cream setting. If it’s crumbly, add a splash of milk and re-spin.
m-reel-ice-cream.note: No pint machine? Freeze in an ice-cube tray and blend the cubes with a splash of milk. Most of the cost is the protein powder (and the pint machine, once); the Greek yogurt freezer cups skip both.

m-sc-salsa-chicken.name: Slow-Cooker Salsa Chicken & Rice
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker. Pour the salsa over it and add the beans, corn, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Cover and cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours, until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the cooker and stir in the lime juice.
Cook the rice, then portion rice and chicken into six containers.
m-sc-salsa-chicken.note: Top with lettuce, the Chipotle Yogurt Sauce or hot sauce. Freezes well without the rice.

m-sc-tikka.name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala
ing: 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
¾ cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
steps: Put the chicken, tomatoes, onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, turmeric and salt in the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours.
Turn the cooker off. Stir in the coconut milk, then the yogurt a spoonful at a time so it stays smooth.
Cook the rice and portion it with the curry into six containers.
m-sc-tikka.note: No yogurt? Use the whole can of coconut milk instead.

m-sc-shawarma.name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Spread the onions in the slow cooker. Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, oil, two-thirds of the garlic, the spices and the salt, and lay it on top.
Cover and cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours, then shred the chicken in the juices.
Stir the rest of the garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt for the sauce.
Cook the rice. Pack rice, chicken and onions, with the cucumbers and sauce in separate small containers.
m-sc-shawarma.note: Leftover juices make the rice taste great: cook the rice in a cup of them plus water.

m-sc-honey-garlic.name: Slow-Cooker Honey-Garlic Chicken
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger in the slow cooker. Add the chicken and turn it to coat.
Cover and cook on low 5 hours or high 2½ hours.
Whisk the cornstarch with 3 tbsp water, stir it in, add the broccoli, and cook on high 30 minutes more, until the sauce thickens.
Cook the rice and portion everything into six containers.
m-sc-honey-garlic.note: Gluten-free? Use tamari instead of soy sauce.

m-sc-lentil-soup.name: Slow-Cooker Lentil & Vegetable Soup
steps: Put everything except the spinach, lemon and yogurt in the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low 7 hours or high 4 hours, until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the spinach and lemon juice until the spinach wilts. Taste for salt.
Portion into six containers and top each with a spoon of yogurt when you eat it.
m-sc-lentil-soup.note: Add a can of chickpeas or some shredded chicken for more protein.

m-froyo-cups.name: Chocolate Greek Yogurt Freezer Cups
steps: Whisk everything until smooth. Taste and add more honey if you like it sweeter.
Spoon into three freezer-safe cups or containers and smooth the tops.
Freeze at least 3 hours.
Let one sit on the counter 10–15 minutes before eating so it scoops like soft-serve.
m-froyo-cups.note: Swirl in a spoon of peanut butter or a few frozen berries before freezing for a change. Blending the frozen cup with a splash of milk makes a thick shake.

m-reel-burger-bowls.name: Lighter Burger Bowls
steps: Brown the beef and onion with the salt, 8–10 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir the yogurt, ketchup and mustard together for the sauce.
Pack the lettuce and tomatoes separately from the warm beef. To eat, top the lettuce with beef, cheese, pickles and sauce.
m-reel-burger-bowls.note: The swaps: lean beef, no bun, yogurt-based sauce. Add a toasted bun on a high-carb day.

b-chicken.name: Baked Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Rub the chicken with the oil, salt and pepper.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, then slice or shred.
b-chicken.note: Cook a double batch plain, split it, and give each half a different flavor.

b-chicken~teriyaki.name: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Make the sauce: simmer the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil and ½ cup water for 2 minutes, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water until thick.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Rub the chicken with the oil, salt and pepper.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, then slice or shred.
Toss the chicken in the sauce, or pack the sauce on the side so it stays fresh.
Top with the sesame seeds and green onions.
b-chicken~teriyaki.note: Cook a double batch plain, split it, and give each half a different flavor.

b-chicken~buffalo.name: Buffalo Chicken
steps: Make the sauce: melt the butter and whisk in the hot sauce and garlic powder. Stir the dill into the yogurt for a dip.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Rub the chicken with the oil, salt and pepper.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, then slice or shred.
Toss the chicken in the sauce, or pack the sauce on the side so it stays fresh.
Serve with the yogurt dip and celery or carrot sticks.
b-chicken~buffalo.note: Cook a double batch plain, split it, and give each half a different flavor.

b-chicken~lemon-herb.name: Lemon Herb Chicken
steps: Mix the zest and juice of the lemons with the garlic, herbs and oil.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Rub the chicken with the oil, salt and pepper. Then rub on the spice mix.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, then slice or shred.
b-chicken~lemon-herb.note: Cook a double batch plain, split it, and give each half a different flavor.

Season with the salt and spoon off any liquid.

b-rice.name: Batch Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

b-rice~cilantro-lime.name: Cilantro Lime Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Fold in the lime zest and juice, cilantro and oil.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

b-rice~coconut-rice.name: Coconut Ginger Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes. Use the coconut milk for part of the water (still 3 cups of liquid in all) and add the ginger.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

b-rice~spanish-rice.name: Spanish Tomato Rice
steps: Before the water, toast the rinsed rice and onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.

Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes. Use the tomato sauce for part of the water (3 cups of liquid in all) and add the cumin and garlic powder.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

b-rice~lemon-rice.name: Lemon Herb Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.

b-rice~sesame-rice.name: Garlic Sesame Fried Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Once the rice is cool, stir-fry the garlic and peas in the sesame oil for 2 minutes, scramble in the eggs, then add the rice and soy sauce and toss until hot. Finish with the green onions.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.

b-rice~turmeric-rice.name: Turmeric Spiced Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes. Add the turmeric, cumin, cinnamon and oil.
Rest 10 minutes covered, then fluff.
Spread on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate within an hour.
Top with the almonds, toasted in a dry pan.

steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, sriracha and garlic with 3–4 tbsp warm water until pourable.

Toss the vegetables with the oil and salt.
Spread over two sheet pans so they roast instead of steam.

Toss the hot vegetables with the sauce.
